name: FLAC++ stream encoder interleaved PCM encoding
description:
HARNESS RULES FOR THIS GROUP: (a) the MAIN PATH below runs on every input with the full input, exactly as listed; it is the baseline, the rest of this Logic Group only adds to it. (b) Entries marked 'same core / alternative' reach the same internal code as the main call: never replace the main call with them and never run all of them on every input (fan-out kills exec/s); if used, run at most one of them as an extra step chosen by spare input bits. (c) A configuration switch must never take inputs away from the main path; options that only add code (e.g. detail/verbose output) stay ON. (d) This list is incomplete; what the project's own fuzzers, tests and examples do with the target stays in scope.
MAIN PATH (keep on every input):
1. A FLAC::Encoder::Stream subclass overriding write_callback (accumulate bytes), seek_callback, tell_callback and metadata_callback (so finish() rewrites STREAMINFO).
2. Before init, from header bytes: set_verify, set_streamable_subset, set_channels(1..8), set_bits_per_sample(4..32), set_sample_rate, set_compression_level(0..8), optional set_blocksize, set_total_samples_estimate, set_num_threads(1..4) and set_limit_min_bitrate. set_num_threads > 1 runs the multithreaded frame encoder (stream_encoder.c:1134, 3441-3552, process_frame_thread_ / process_frame_thread_inner_ at 3705); the project's own fuzzers set it (oss-fuzz/encoder_v2.cc:124, oss-fuzz/reencoder.cc:201,261). Both previous LG harnesses dropped num_threads, streamable_subset and limit_min_bitrate.
3. KEEP THE COMPRESSION-LEVEL PRESETS on most inputs: set_compression_level installs apodization "tukey(5e-1)" / "subdivide_tukey(2|3)", LPC order, partition orders (compression_levels_ table, stream_encoder.c:129-138; applied at 1873+). The individual overrides (set_do_mid_side_stereo, set_loose_mid_side_stereo, set_max_lpc_order, set_qlp_coeff_precision, set_do_qlp_coeff_prec_search, set_do_escape_coding, set_do_exhaustive_model_search, set_min/max_residual_partition_order, set_apodization) are applied ONLY when one flag bit is set (as oss-fuzz/encoder_v2.cc 'bias towards regular compression levels'); applying a single apodization on every input removed the subdivide_tukey / partial windowing code (set_next_subdivide_tukey, FLAC__lpc_window_data_partial).
4. Metadata: FLAC__metadata_object_new PADDING and VORBIS_COMMENT (FLAC__metadata_object_vorbiscomment_entry_from_name_value_pair + append_comment), set_metadata; free them after finish.
5. init() or init_ogg() by a flag; samples built from the remaining bytes with 1..4 bytes per sample and clamped to the configured bits_per_sample range (cap ~20000 samples for speed); process_interleaved(buffer, samples) and then a SECOND process_interleaved on part of the same buffer (multi-call block accumulation); finish(); get_state().as_cstring() / resolved_as_cstring(encoder); on failure get_verify_decoder_state() and get_verify_decoder_error_stats().
ADDITIONS on top (spare bits): process() non-interleaved (same core / alternative) for the second call only, an apodization string list on override inputs (window.c functions), samples==0 edge.

FEATURE DESCRIPTION (from the Logic Group stage):
FLAC::Encoder::Stream::process_interleaved() is the C++ wrapper that feeds raw, attacker-controllable interleaved PCM samples into the libFLAC stream encoder state machine. It de-interleaves the samples into the encoder's internal per-channel signal buffers, validates each sample against the configured bit depth, and once a full block (+1 overread sample) has accumulated it calls into process_frame_() which selects a subframe coding method (constant/fixed/LPC/verbatim) per channel, optionally does mid/side stereo decorrelation, Rice-codes residuals, writes frame headers/CRCs to the bitwriter, and (if verify is enabled) feeds the encoded frame back through a shadow decoder to check it decodes identically. Because nearly every step depends on encoder configuration (channels, bits-per-sample, blocksize, compression level, LPC order, apodization windows, partition orders, mid-side/verify flags) set before init(), this is a rich feature surface where malformed sample values, extreme configuration combinations, or buffer/overread edge cases can trigger out-of-bounds writes, integer overflow in bit computations, or state-machine misuse.
- process_interleaved: target; drives interleaved raw samples into the per-channel integer_signal buffers, performs range/overread bookkeeping, and triggers process_frame_() once a block is full.
- process: variant; same as process_interleaved but takes non-interleaved (per-channel array-of-pointers) buffers, exercising the parallel de-interleave-free code path in FLAC__stream_encoder_process() while sharing process_frame_()/process_subframes_().
- init: lifecycle/config application point; calls FLAC__stream_encoder_init_stream() which validates and locks in channels/bits-per-sample/sample-rate/blocksize/compression settings and allocates the internal signal buffers that process_interleaved writes into.
- init_ogg: variant; initializes the encoder for Ogg-FLAC output (FLAC__stream_encoder_init_ogg_stream), exercising the Ogg packet-wrapping write path in addition to native FLAC framing.
- finish: consumer/lifecycle; flushes any partially-filled final block (forces process_frame_() on the remaining samples with is_last_block=true) and finalizes/updates STREAMINFO, so fuzzing without calling finish misses the last-frame and verify-flush code paths.
- set_channels / set_bits_per_sample / set_blocksize / set_compression_level / set_do_mid_side_stereo / set_loose_mid_side_stereo / set_apodization / set_max_lpc_order / set_qlp_coeff_precision / set_do_qlp_coeff_prec_search / set_do_escape_coding / set_do_exhaustive_model_search / set_min_residual_partition_order / set_max_residual_partition_order / set_verify: configuration setters that select different branches inside process_subframe_/process_subframes_ (which subframe type/predictor is tried, whether mid-side decorrelation is attempted, Rice partition search range, verify round-trip decoding).
The input space the harness should vary: the raw interleaved FLAC__int32 sample buffer (values near INT32_MIN/MAX relative to the configured bits-per-sample to hit the sample_min/sample_max range check), the `samples` count (0, less than one block, exactly one block, spanning many blocks to exercise the overread/blocksize wraparound logic), and the encoder configuration prior to init(): channels (1-8), bits_per_sample (4-32), blocksize, compression_level (0-8, which implicitly sets many of the booleans/orders above), do_mid_side_stereo/loose_mid_side_stereo, apodization specification strings, max_lpc_order (0 selects fixed-predictor-only path vs >0 selects LPC path), qlp_coeff_precision, do_qlp_coeff_prec_search, do_escape_coding, do_exhaustive_model_search, min/max_residual_partition_order, verify on/off (enables the shadow-decoder consistency check), and choosing init() (native FLAC) vs init_ogg() (Ogg-wrapped) output.
